verdict.rationale: The API shows URL-path versioning: endpoints sit under api.beglaubigt.de/v1. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, changelog or version-migration guidance, so only the versioning half of the story is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, changelog or version history, sunset/notice periods, multiple-version support details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
